meta.tagline: Every IT course summary in one place
meta.description: A non-profit student platform gathering the IT department's summaries, lectures, sheets, videos and quizzes, run by outstanding students to help their peers.

home.heroTitle: Every IT course summary in one place
home.heroSubtitle: Read the summaries, watch the videos and take the quizzes without ever leaving the site. Your progress is saved automatically, so you pick up exactly where you stopped on any device.
home.featuresSubtitle: Built around the problems students actually hit every term.
home.feature1Body: Summaries open directly in the platform with no downloads and no external apps, and the page you reached is remembered for you.
home.feature2Body: The site stores your position in every document and video, and shows a "continue where you left off" list on every visit.
home.feature3Body: Short quizzes for each chapter with instant marking and explained answers, plus points and badges for top students.
home.feature4Body: The structure you already know — level, then term, then course, then exam phase — but with search and filters that work in Arabic.
home.feature5Body: Videos play inside the platform and resume from the exact second you stopped.
home.feature6Body: The code is open source, and any university can run its own copy with its own content.
home.howStep1Title: Sign up with your university email
home.howStep1Body: Create an account with your university address and an admin will approve it.
home.howStep2Body: Go to your department, level and term, then pick the course you are studying.
home.howStep3Body: Read, watch and take quizzes. The platform remembers everything for you.
home.ctaBody: The platform is completely free and run by students like you.
home.contributorsBody: The content comes from outstanding students and admins, and every file credits its author.

about.title: About IT-SUM
about.missionBody: IT-SUM is a non-profit educational platform built by students to help their peers. The goal is simple: a student should find everything a course needs — a summary, a video, a sheet, a quiz — in one place, without digging through chat groups or downloading scattered files.
about.nonProfitBody: No ads, no subscriptions, no data selling. The platform runs on free or low-cost services and the code is open source.
about.adminsBody: The admins are outstanding students from the same department. They add the summaries and quizzes and review new accounts, and every administrative action is recorded in an audit log.
about.openSourceBody: The platform was built to be copied: any university can run its own instance with its own content, logo and departments without editing code.
about.creditsBody: Every student who contributed a summary, an explanation or a correction. Contributor names appear on each file.
